name: Benchmark Wooden Chair 04
prompt: Create a simple wooden dining chair, a single freestanding piece of furniture with exactly four straight vertical legs, one flat square horizontal seat, and one tall wooden backrest rising from the rear edge. There are no arms, no cushions, and no other objects. Use dark stained oak wood with slightly beveled edges and visible timber grain. This should look like a recognizably ordinary human-sized four-legged chair, not a building, not a display plinth, and not an animal. Make an editable 3D Blender mesh, save and render the project, then open the new model in Blender.
